title: Map an AI Agent Workflow
description: Design a multi-step agent workflow on paper — without building it — to understand how agentic tasks are structured.
steps: Choose a multi-step task you currently do manually (e.g. researching a company, processing applications, weekly status report)
Map the current manual process as a flowchart
For each step, ask: could an AI agent do this? What tool would it use?
Redesign the workflow with AI agent steps: specify trigger, tools, decision points, human checkpoints
Identify where human review is essential vs where AI can operate autonomously
expectedOutput: A before-and-after workflow diagram showing manual vs AI-agent-assisted process.
bonusChallenges: Estimate time savings if the agent workflow were implemented
Identify the highest-risk step and design a guardrail for it
